# Development Across Timescales (DAT) Research Group

  </div>
</div>

### What do we do?

In the DAT research group, we use interdisciplinary approaches to understand development across multiple timescales, from in-the-moment adaptations in conversation, to language learning within the lifespan, and to cross-generational developments across generations.

### Join my Research Group!

I am always happy to talk with students who are curious about the intersection of **psychology and data science** — whether that means studying how people think and learn, building tools to study cognition, or applying computational methods to behavioral data.

I am not actively recruiting research assistants at the moment, but you are still welcome to contact me if you are interested! No prior research experience is required, though, due to the type of data that we collect and work with, programming skills are very beneficial.

You can email me at cain1 [at] kenyon.edu or fill out this **[interest survey form](https://forms.gle/xM6cNVmArnaFbZik7)**. See the [research tab](projects.html) for what I'm working on.
